records.title: Green Energy Corridor Phase- III Project in Andhra Pradesh
details: c to e: The proposals submitted by various State Transmission Utilities (STUs) for consideration under GEC-III scheme, have been technically scrutinized and vetted by CEA and forwarded to this Ministry which is under consideration.

records.title: Medical Devices Manufacturers
details: c: Under the scheme, three parks have been approved and are at an advanced stages of development in Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh), Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh) and Kanchipuram (Tamil Nadu).

records.title: Status of Driver Training Institutes
details: c: The rest of the proposals are at different stages of examination and evaluation.

records.title: National Urban Digital Mission
details:
i. The Scheme of National Urban Digital Mission (NUDM) for the
period 2025-29 is under consideration.
ii. The
Urban Platform for DeliverY of Online Governance (UPYOG) Portal is
being developed as a proof of concept for urban service delivery and its
full rollout will occur during the Mission Period post-implementation.

records.title: Software Exports from Software Technology Parks
details:
a to d: The incubation center at Andhra University is being developed on a 1-acre land allotted by
the Andhra Pradesh Government near Andhra University Tech Hub (a-hub), A.U. College
of Engineering Area (North Campus), Visakhapatnam. STPI has planned a ground plus 4
floors building with a built-up area of about 30,000 sq. ft., estimated to cost Rs. 18.95
crore from its internal accruals. The tendering process has concluded, and work has been
awarded on 29.10.2024

records.title: Implementation of Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
details: The Government of Andhra Pradesh has reported that Pathivada Baripeda village of Pusapatirega Mandal, Vizianagaram District has been chosen under 100 Climate Resilient Coastan Fishermen villages component of PMMSY and three floating jetties at Mukkam Village, Tippalavalasa Village and Chintapalli Villages of Vizianagaram District have been planned under Sagarmala Scheme. All these projects are at Detailed Project Report (DPR) Preparation stage.
